reviews.title: App crash

reviews.title: Was good, but not now
reviews.text: I’ve been using this app for a while - for years actually. And it’s usually been solid. But I just recorded a whole podcast and it was very glitchy. It was taking an exceedingly long time to save to my phone and to get back to the script screen. Anyway, after an hour of recording, I just looked at the footage that was saved on my phone and the same footage saved in the app and it’s very glitchy. Every two or three seconds there’s a Freeze frame so I just lost a tremendous amount of my time and this is obviously frustrating.

reviews.title: Used to be great. Quality down recently
reviews.text: This app used to be one of the best apps and most helpful for my business and content creation. However, over the last few months the quality has deteriorated and I have no idea why. The app has been switching mics sources from my DJI to the iPhone mid recording. If I don’t download my video to my phone immediately I lose all the footage which you can imagine is quite a problem after recording hours of content. and it has been cutting off mid recording. So I will be in the middle of recording and it just stops. I’ve been using this for years and have never had issues like this but it’s been progressively getting worst recently and with even Instagram now having a built in teleprompter and free versions of other teleprompters not giving me this type of trouble I think it is unlikely that I will renew my subscription when it ends as I now have to resort to other means to record my content as I have no confidence in this app anymore.

reviews.title: Can't Adjust Front Camera
reviews.text: In other apps, I'm able to switch from close to wide angle on the front camera. With this app I'm not able to, so that's why I'm giving it a one star.

reviews.title: Eerie Eye Tracking
reviews.text: The first time I used the edit tool to enhance eye tracking, I discovered that it gave me a totally different eye color. There was no way to reverse it and go back to the original recording. That was my best take out of about 10 takes and I was very disappointed because I looked like an alien with the new eye color. I can’t use it now because without a doubt, people think that it was AI and not really me. I wish the app had an ability to revert to original in their editing tools.
